# Distant Supervision for Relation Extraction without Labeled Data

**Authors:** Evgeniy Gabrilovich, Michael Ringgaard, Amarnag Subramanya  
**Year:** 2017  
**Journal:** ACL  
**DOI:** [10.3115/1690219.1690287](https://doi.org/10.3115/1690219.1690287)  
**Publisher:** [https://aclanthology.org/P09-1113/](https://aclanthology.org/P09-1113/)

**Keywords:** relation extraction, distant supervision

## Abstract

We investigate an alternative approach to relation extraction that does not require any manually labeled training data.
